headline: A$AP Rocky wants to be the next Black James Bond He told Variety at the Academy Museum Gal
body: A$AP Rocky wants to be the next Black James Bond He told Variety at the Academy Museum Gala that he’d love to play 007, and he’s not opposed to sharing the screen with Rihanna. It’s not the first time he’s put his name in the conversation. He’s been saying it since last year. He also told The Hollywood Reporter that teasing new Rihanna music earlier this year turned out to be hell. Could Rocky pull off 007, or should he stick to music?
